stories.h: IDF says Israel could hit Iran without US help
stories.s: Military spokesman Effie Defrin told Kan that Israel can strike Iran at any moment, even alone. Netanyahu is convening his security cabinet Thursday evening amid reports of preparations for renewed action; Mossad researchers reportedly see no urgent need.

stories.h: Eisenkot's Yashar restarts coalition talks with Golan's Democrats
stories.s: Two days after Yair Golan froze negotiations over Yashar's parallel talks with Likud, Yashar says marathon sessions resume Thursday. Golan reportedly wants a top ministry; Eisenkot is said to offer only national security.

stories.h: Netanyahu demands immediate end to his corruption trial
stories.s: After judges questioned the bribery count, Netanyahu called the trial fabricated and said it must stop now. Attorney General Baharav-Miara, appearing in court, said prosecutors will weigh the remarks and are open to a negotiated ending.

stories.h: Kushner presses Netanyahu on Gaza aid and multinational force
stories.s: In a Tuesday-night call, the US envoy urged Netanyahu to let more humanitarian supplies into Gaza ahead of winter and to approve deploying international troops. A Board of Peace source described the conversation as very positive.

stories.h: Karhi media law repeal clears Knesset first reading
stories.s: Lawmakers voted 51-32 Wednesday to scrap Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi's Broadcasting Law and restore the prior framework. Karhi protested the rushed process; the bill returns to committee before final readings.

coming.s: Netanyahu convenes his security cabinet Thursday evening amid reports Israel and the US are preparing for possible renewed strikes on Iran.

coming.h: Eisenkot bloc's target date to swear in government
coming.s: Channel 12 reports the Eisenkot-led bloc hopes to swear in a new government as soon as next Wednesday, pending deals with Bennett and the Democrats.
